why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 52 covers 24th-27th, sheet 57 covers 27th-30th; 27th is the only shared street. Both plates print '27TH ST.' in it and both print the width '80''. Address runs pin the block: sheet 52's north frontage of 27th reads 1702 1704 1706 1708 1710 1712 | 1714 1716 1718 1720 1722 1724 (the Avenue O to Avenue O 1/2 block, split by the 20' alley), with the Avenue O 1/2 corner numbers 2623 2625 2627 / 2626 2628 turning north; sheet 57's south frontage reads 1401 1403 1405 1407 1409 1411 1413 | 1415 1417 1419 1421 1423 (its Avenue N to Avenue N 1/2 block, 'BLEACHER' sheds), the two sheets meeting at Avenue N. The intermediate streets rule out an off-by-one: sheet 52's next street north is '25TH ST. OR ROSENBERG AV.' (drafted 120' wide, faces 1199/1560) and then 26TH (faces 2470/2709); sheet 57's next street south is 28th (faces 1248/1492). Detection's candidates (52: 3270/2129/988; 57: 674/1824/2974) were discarded. Sheet 52 draws only the north half of 27th - the plate ends at y~3766 - so its centre is taken as the north face y=3618 plus half of the printed 80' (121 px) = 3739, which lands exactly on the printed '80'' annotation and agrees with the 26th-centre + block-depth chain (2589.5 + 1149). Sheet 57 has both faces, y=105 and y=345 -> 222.
